run_pybullet_mp4_recording: run a pybullet simulation that records an MP4 video of a falling R2D2 robot at 240fps
configure_debug_visualizer_single_step: configure the pybullet debug visualizer to enable single step rendering for synchronized video frames
load_urdf_models: load URDF models like a ground plane and R2D2 robot into the pybullet simulation environment
step_simulation_with_debug_text: step the pybullet simulation forward while adding and removing frame number debug text overlays
change_dynamics_linear_damping: change the dynamics of a pybullet body to disable linear damping for free-fall physics
